snippet.title: Variety Vault Plus! - Official Mod Showcase
snippet.description:
DOWNLOAD MOD HERE!!: https://gamebanana.com/mods/719888

THE MOD IS FINALLY OUTTTTTTTT YAAAAAAYYYY!!! After nearly 2 years of development... we finally made it.. ty all for the support these past couple of years! without all of you and especially without this wonderful team, this never would have came to be... PLEASE check out the mod if youre able to and 1000% support everyone in the credits because this thing would never have seen the light of day without each and every person in there :D

VV+ Community Server: https://discord.com/invite/MJRTkmqa2w
Gameplay by: https://bsky.app/profile/stickwhiskers.bsky.social
My Twitter: https://twitter.com/Antreys_

The Varied Magic of FNF & VV Continues!
A brand new Variety Vault release has hit the scene! Now including more content than ever before! Revisit the magic and fun of 12 beautiful games, now on your Personal Computer! All of these wonderful games have been powered up with a refreshing rhythm-based twist on their standard gameplay; made possible only through the hit Newgrounds game, Friday Night Funkin'! All neatly wrapped together into one wondrously bountiful package titled;

Friday Night Funkin': Variety Vault Plus!

Includes:
- 12 Great games & 17(?) songs to play/discover in the Game Select Menu. 
- Majorly revamped/remade songs & visuals for many of the V1 songs. 
- An abundance of unlockable & customizable content. 
- Various difficult, yet engaging mechanics. 
- A gallery menu that offers dev insight, a peek behind the scenes, and bonus songs!
- A multitude of custom HUDs, Pause Menus, & UI Themes. 
- And many, MANY more secrets to discover.
